purpose: Calibrate large-design mixing and choose an outcome-blind informative-assignment dose before generating any responses or fitting any estimator.

design.person_distribution: one frozen N(0,1) draw, standardized to mean 0 and population SD 0.8

dose_selection_rule.rule: Choose the largest eligible absolute gamma for which both signs satisfy every chain gate and the registered correlation magnitude and symmetry range. Do not inspect responses, because none exist in this phase.

claim_boundary: This calibrates finite-chain behavior for one frozen 80-by-4 coordinate configuration; it does not prove universal mixing.
The selected gamma is a simulation dose, not an estimate of a real assignment mechanism.
No estimator and no FACETS output is used in dose selection.
Downstream estimator evidence must use a separately frozen response-study plan.
